product.description: Monoprice™Ultra Low-Profile Full Motion TV Wall Mount Bracket for 40" to 75" TVs up to 110lbs, Max VESA 400x400The Monoprice Ultra Low-Profile Full Motion TV Wall Mount Bracket is meticulously designed to securely hold your TV as close to the wall as possible while still allowing for extension and off-angle viewing. When flush against the wall, the mount is nearly imperceptible, sitting just 0.77 inches away. Paired with ultra-thin TVs, it creates a sleek and minimalistic appearance, protruding only slightly more than a picture frame.This slim yet sturdy full-motion mount accommodates displays ranging from 40 to 75 inches, with a weight capacity of 110 pounds, making it an excellent choice for medium to large screens. Unlike traditional low-profile mounts that are fixed to the wall and limit you to a single viewing angle, this exceptionally thin, full-motion mount extends out 9.8 inches, making it perfect for spacious rooms with larger seating areas.Traditional full-motion big screen TV mounts often suffer from an unsightly appearance due to their industrial metal brackets and messy cables. Each time you pull the TV away from the wall, this eyesore becomes visible and detracts from your room’s overall decor. However, the Monoprice Premium Full Motion TV Wall Mount features a concealed cable management system and a covered mounting base, ensuring a polished and high-end appearance even when the TV is fully extended.The Monoprice Ultra Low-Profile Full Motion TV Wall Mount Bracket goes beyond its full articulation capabilities. It swivels up to 60 degrees, allowing you to align the TV with your seating position. Additionally, it offers upward or downward screen tilt, which helps combat glare from lighting or nearby windows. The level rotation adjustment ensures that your display remains perfectly horizontal at all times, regardless of whether you’re standing, sitting, or even lying on the floor. This wall mount provides the flexibility you need for optimal viewing angles.In terms of compatibility, the Monoprice bracket supports VESA mounting patterns from 100 x 200 up to 400 x 400. This broad range covers the majority of modern displays. Plus, it comes with all the necessary mounting hardware, so you won’t need to make any unnecessary trips to the local hardware store.The Monoprice Ultra Low-Profile Full Motion TV Wall Mount Bracket offers an elegant and practical solution for mounting TVs ranging from 40 to 75 inches. Its sleek, nearly flush design ensures that you don’t have to sacrifice aesthetics for functionality. With full-motion capabilities, tilt adjustment, and swivel options, this bracket provides flexibility while maintaining a low profile.
